title: UFO whistleblowers allowed to disclose classified data | FOX 10 Talks
description: Harvard professor Dr. Avi Loeb joined FOX to discuss major federal updates regarding unidentified anomalous phenomena, known as UAP. A new presidential directive now allows former federal employees and defense contractors investigating UAP phenomenon to speak directly with government task forces without fear of violating non-disclosure agreements. Additionally, an amendment introduced by Representative Eric Burlison to the defense budget establishes a national review board to analyze classified data and recommend public release.
